title: Incident 51000001074180 : [BC-IN] GST Component code alignment issue in Pay GST Calculation details.
summary: GST Settlement calculation now processes components in the configured Return & Reco Sequence order instead of alphabetically, ensuring correct Credit Utilized and Surplus Credit display in Pay GST Calculation Details.
key_points: Settlement procedures in GST Settlement codeunit now use SetCurrentKey with Sequence No. to iterate in correct order
GST Payment Buffer Details table adds LineOrder key for consistent display sorting
Pay GST Calculation Details page sorts by Line No. to show components in configured sequence
Calculation and posting logic unchanged; only iteration and display order corrected
Fixes GST component processing for India localization with multiple liability components
quote: Process GST Payment Buffer in Return & Reco Component Sequence No. order instead of clustered GST Component Code order during settlement calculation.
